acceptanceCriteria: The spec header delivery status, Agent digest and line-47 text state what is true: implemented and produced on main, technical contract proposed and not promoted, qualification bounded. No claim of acceptance or stable promotion.
CEM-V1-107..112 show their acceptance basis (standing auto-accept, 2026-10-11) in the spec and the generated REQUIREMENTS.tsv/INDEX.json.
The 12 doc gates pass, and sealed change evidence is retained.
body: docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md at origin/main 92c298a6e says 'Delivery status: planned' (line 4). The Agent digest says 'technical contract proposed/planned; no stable delivery or promotion', but the Core cem/1.0 producer and dogfood cutover are accepted and on main (CEM-V1-140..152, V1-1276; decision 0525). The V1-1333 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#879) relabelled the protocol/cem-1.0 packet as IMPLEMENTED_CONTRACT_PROPOSED_NOT_PROMOTED. Per its charter it left the spec header alone, so the spec and the packet now disagree. Codex flagged the header, the digest and the line-47 'planned' text in that lane. The same follow-up should record the new CEM-V1-107..112 (proposed in #879) under the owner's standing auto-accept of lane requirements (2026-10-11), if they were not already recorded on merge.
title: cem-stable-v1.md header and digest still say delivery planned while the cem/1.0 producer ships on main
